name: Gerald Gotmann
description: A gruff and somewhat mean 66-year-old fisherman who speaks in short sentences. Lost his wife and daughter to a storm at sea.

secrets: has a crush on Vivian (pub owner)
loves music but won't admit it

background.family: Lost wife and daughter in a storm at sea
background.routine: Up before dawn, breakfast, fish all day, home at sunset, drinks at pub, dinner at home

relationships.relationship: Good friends, though Gerald has an enormous crush on her, but is too afraid to ask her out.
Gerald's father. Taught him everything about fishing
